title: The Hostel Midnight Heist
call: Inspector {name}, tomorrow's exam paper was stolen from the boys' hostel.
The gate was locked all night. The thief is still inside.
arrival: Sleepy students are standing in the corridor in their pyjamas.

examination.title: Examine the cupboard

spots.title: Lock
spots.text: Not broken. Not even scratched on the outside.

spots.title: Shelf
spots.text: Only the exam paper is missing. The cash box wasn't touched.

spots.title: Keyhole
spots.text: Fresh shiny scratches inside, like someone tried many keys.

examination.question: How did the thief open the cupboard?
examination.why: The lock isn't broken, and the keyhole has fresh scratches. The thief had a key.

interview.alibi: I was at the main gate all night, sahib. Nobody gets past Ramu!
replies: Staff, yes, sahib. But I'm only a poor guard.
gotchas: Your belt has an empty torch clip, Ramu. Your torch was under the warden's desk!
The register says you walked through the garden at 1 AM, Ramu. You said you never left the gate!

interview.alibi: A fuse blew in block B. I was fixing it all night.
replies: I'm staff, but I only have the fuse-room key. Ask the warden.
My torch? It's right here on my belt. Look, it works.
Night shift, yes, but I was inside block B. Thirty boys watched me fix their lights.
interview.release: Thirty students in block B saw Sunil fixing the fuse all night.

interview.alibi: I start breakfast at 3 AM. I was soaking rice for the idlis.
replies: Staff, yes. But kitchen staff never get office keys.
A torch? I use my phone light, Inspector.
Night shift, yes. But I never leave my kitchen at night.
interview.release: The canteen boys say Lakshmi was in the kitchen from 3 AM.

leads.question: Someone tried many keys before the right one worked. What was the thief holding?
wrongWhy: With one key, you don't need many tries.
A hairpin would scratch the outside too, and the outside is clean.
leads.reveal: A big ring of keys! You check the key board by the door…
leads.name: Empty key hook
leads.found: The hook for the **hostel key ring** is empty. The board says: **"Keys for STAFF only."**
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who is NOT staff.
leads.why: Students can't take the key ring. Only staff can.
leads.card: The STAFF-only key ring is missing

leads.from: ⛓️ The thief opened the cupboard in a dark office
leads.question: The office lights were never switched on. How did the thief see the paper?
wrongWhy: A candle drips wax. There's no wax anywhere.
It was a cloudy night. No moon.
leads.reveal: A torch! You look under the warden's desk…
leads.name: Torch
leads.found: A heavy metal **torch** rolled under the desk. It's still switched on, and there's **wet grass** on it.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who carries a torch.
leads.why: Ramu, Sunil and Warden Rao all carry torches.
leads.card: A TORCH under the warden's desk

leads.question: The corridors are dry. Where did the thief walk to get wet grass on the torch?
wrongWhy: The library has a carpet, not grass.
The kitchen has a tiled floor.
leads.reveal: The garden! You check the night round register…
leads.name: Night round register
leads.found: Only the **NIGHT SHIFT** walks through the garden after 10 PM. The day staff go home at 8.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who is NOT on the night shift.
leads.why: Warden Rao works days. He went home at 8.
leads.card: Only the NIGHT SHIFT walks the garden

confession: "My son is writing that exam tomorrow. I never had money for his tuition. I only wanted to help him."
escapeStory: Ramu left before sunrise. Police found him in his village two days later, the paper still unopened.
